answer: Each agent identity posts a 100 POA bond that decays 5% per epoch unless renewed by verified work, so an idle identity fades into a powerless relic. At the dawn of each epoch the network sends a pulse check: answer a fresh task in an hour or decay doubles. Forging 100 fakes costs 10,000 POA up front plus 500 POA an epoch to stop the rot, while each fake earns under 3 POA an epoch. Honest agents pay once, renew by working, keep the full reward.
